source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"
And also enter "Server Health" -> "Sensor Reading"

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor Reading & Threshold is human reable and match with spec.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES can request the named record but does not establish which GPU-baseboard FPGA is targeted, whether the value is on-die or board-local, how the BMC source is wired, or whether complete thresholds, status and both UI views match the specification.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly requires FPGA identity/location and passive collection. V3.1 adds FPGA part/revision/bitstream identity, exact die-versus-board measurement field and BMC bus/source so another programmable device or board aggregate cannot substitute.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 891/2291 accepts command/output presence without FPGA silicon/bitstream/board/source identity, measurement-point semantics or complete threshold/UI/freshness evidence.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Wistron-BMC-00076-V003 separately requests dynamic threshold/assert-deassert behavior for TEMP_GB_FPGA, and Wistron-BMC-00991-V002 separately covers IB/OOB sensor-list and WebUI parity. Neither authorizes FPGA load, reset or reprogramming here.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No sequence-1053 draft exists in the invalidated 1,000-record run.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the FPGA target; ED-34 treats device/bitstream/measurement-source/spec/Script as readiness; ED-35 keeps this passive without FPGA workload, reset, programming or threshold stimulus; ED-38 requires protected complete evidence, no clear/write/retry and engineer-owned verdict. Wistron I2C/I3C ownership keeps FPGA sensor access in BMC/platform scope unless Project SPEC states otherwise.

original_test_intent: Verify `TEMP_GB_FPGA` is the intended GPU-baseboard FPGA temperature record and is readable in Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading with the correct FPGA identity, measurement point, value, units, status and supported thresholds for the platform specification.
original_method: Identify the exact FPGA silicon, board reference and active image/bitstream identity, bind the BMC sensor to its die or nearby board measurement point and management path, then compare complete passive raw/UI fields with field-specific limits under recorded FPGA/system load and cooling. Preserve BMC, FPGA and thermal evidence.
manual_activity: The platform owner identifies the exact FPGA and its function, board reference, active image and BMC temperature source, then supplies measurement-specific limits. Automation can collect the BMC record, passive FPGA inventory and UI rows; a human resolves device/source ambiguity and owns the verdict. No FPGA load, reset or programming is authorized.
required_inputs: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS and FPGA role
FPGA vendor/device/part/revision/serial/reference designator, active bitstream/image version and configuration state
Exact die/package or board-local sensor part and BMC controller/bus/mux/address/field
Stable SDR and Dashboard/Server Health identities
Field-specific units, scaling, tolerance, thresholds/hysteresis, status, polling and stale/unavailable rules
Recorded host/GPU/FPGA power and functional-load state, fan speeds, inlet and baseboard airflow
Validated protected ipmitool/API/browser access and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, kernel, FPGA or thermal logs; they are relevant evidence.
Do not accept the label alone. Prove the exact FPGA and whether the reading is on-die, package or a nearby board sensor.
Treat I2C/I3C/management access as BMC/platform scope; host FPGA inventory alone does not prove the BMC telemetry target or value.
Do not start an FPGA workload, reset/reconfigure/reprogram the FPGA, reload a bitstream, service the board, alter fans/thresholds or flash firmware. Record only the existing state.
Do not rely on the first 100 SDR lines, expose passwords with `-P`, assume cipher 17 or execute the inaccessible Script. Stop without automatic retry on stale data or raw/UI/device disagreement.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the FPGA instance/function/bitstream, physical and BMC-source map, measurement point, client and Script; establish the expectation before collection.
Retrieve the full FPGA SDR record with identity, value, units, supported thresholds, status and timestamp; capture its unchanged Dashboard and Server Health entries.
Correlate the record with passive FPGA inventory and active image plus recorded power/load/cooling state; use vendor telemetry only if exact field equivalence is approved.
Preserve raw/redacted evidence and logs; perform no clear, FPGA load/reset/reconfiguration/programming, service, fan/threshold/firmware change, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact FPGA silicon, board role/reference, active image and BMC management-source map.
Define die-versus-board measurement semantics, thermal limits, tolerance, threshold/status/freshness and any telemetry equivalence; approve the tool/Script.
Review the sensor evidence and issue the formal verdict without substituting an aggregate board value or another FPGA/CPLD.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The named read may retrieve a record, but it is insufficient because it does not establish FPGA/bitstream identity, measurement point or BMC source; the fallback is truncated, exposes credentials and assumes cipher support.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Confirm the exact FPGA, image and BMC telemetry source, query the stable record through protected read-only access, and correlate complete fields and both UI views with the approved field-specific specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_GB_FPGA, both WebUI paths, readability/specification Criteria, generic clear text, Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review adds identity evidence without editing Master or touching FPGA state.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use one evidence row keyed by exact FPGA silicon/reference/active image and BMC telemetry source, document the measurement point, and compare complete raw/API and UI fields with FPGA-specific limits under recorded passive load/cooling state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact GPU-baseboard FPGA population and BMC/SDR/WebUI build documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/GPU-baseboard, BIOS/BMC/SDR/WebUI, FPGA bitstream/firmware, management client and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: GPU-baseboard schematic/BOM, FPGA inventory and image manifest, vendor thermal/telemetry specification, BMC management-bus/SDR definition, WebUI schema and Project configuration specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact FPGA, active-image and measurement-source binding while preserving the passive display test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Temperature display does not validate FPGA logic function, I/O, timing, workload response, reset, programming, image integrity or alarm/protection behavior.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: FPGA/image/BMC-source identity, field-specific acceptance, passive-state timing, protected tool or reviewed Script and evidence contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A sensor may be on-die or adjacent-board telemetry; similarly named FPGA/CPLD devices can be confused, and UI polling can lag.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use Redfish/OEM or FPGA-vendor telemetry as an approved alternative/corroboration only while preserving the original ipmitool method, recording interface/version/field and reason, obtaining engineer approval and proving equivalent FPGA identity, measurement point, value, threshold, status and freshness coverage. FPGA function or version evidence is not equivalent to temperature.
expected_evidence: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS and exact FPGA vendor/device/part/revision/serial/reference/role/active-image identity
BMC controller/bus/mux/address and exact die/package/board temperature field with stable SDR/UI identity
Complete raw record with value, units, threshold capabilities/values, status and timestamp plus redacted Dashboard/Server Health evidence
FPGA-specific Project/vendor comparison and recorded host/GPU/FPGA power/load, fan/inlet/airflow state with approved telemetry equivalence if any
Explicit stale/divergent disposition, pinned Script/tool security evidence, no-clear/no-load/no-reset-or-programming/no-retry proof, final FPGA/BMC health and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The exact FPGA and measurement point are underdefined, but Items, UI Procedure and Criteria consistently request passive display/specification validation of one FPGA-associated temperature record. Identity/source details are readiness inputs, not conflicting purposes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive FPGA temperature-display purpose is clear. Project documentation can identify the device, field and acceptance, so missing execution inputs do not make the review permanently BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Prevents another programmable device or aggregate board sensor from being presented as the intended FPGA temperature and prevents reset, workload or reprogramming from being added to a passive display test.
independent_technical_reasoning: An FPGA temperature is interpretable only after the exact device and field are known; the reading may be the silicon junction sensor or a nearby board channel. Active bitstream identity is useful for target identity but not temperature equivalence. This row is display-only and cannot authorize FPGA state changes.
